description:
## Problem
- The incomplete-configuration errors name environment variables as a way to configure the platform. The builders never read them; only `${VAR}` inside the credentials file works.
  - Locations: `platforms/azure_synapse.py:115-137`, `platforms/fabric_warehouse.py:112-123`, `platforms/databricks/adapter.py:347-357`, `utils/cloud_storage.py:537`, `security/credentials.py:54`.
- A CI user who exports the named variables gets the same error again.
- `build_fabric_spark_config_from_env` (`platforms/credentials/fabric_spark.py:7`) is dead code.

## Change
Do one of the following:
- Read the variables in the builders, with precedence explicit > environment > saved and the source recorded.
- Or reword the messages to point at `benchbox setup` or `${VAR}` in credentials.yaml.

In either case, delete or wire up the dead env builder.
